description: Crypto options positioning (Deribit) for one underlying: total call/put open interest in coins and USD notional, put/call OI and volume ratios, largest strike concentrations, upcoming expirations with expiring notional and theoretical max pain, OI change over 24h/7d (from hourly snapshots), and recent trade flow (aggressor premium by calls/puts, block share, largest trades). Descriptive positioning — not a direction signal.

expiries.description: Upcoming expirations to list, default 6, max 20.

trades_hours.description: Trade-flow window in hours, default 4, max 24; 0 skips trades.

name: options_positioning

caveat.description: What the numbers do not say: positioning and pricing, not direction; max pain is theoretical

maxPainTheoretical.description: Strike minimising the total holder payout; a theoretical calculation, not a forecast

holderPayoutUsd.description: Total holder payout at that strike, USD

shareOfOiPct.description: This expiry's share of total OI notional, percent

callNotionalUsd.description: Call OI notional, USD (calculated at the spot index)

putCallOi.description: Put OI ÷ call OI; absent without call OI

putCallVolume.description: Put ÷ call 24h volume; absent when no calls traded

putNotionalUsd.description: Put OI notional, USD (calculated at the spot index)

meta.description: Provenance of the snapshot the numbers come from

ageSeconds.description: Seconds between the observation and this response

observedAt.description: When the venue snapshot was observed, ISO 8601 UTC

metricSources.description: Which fields the venue reports and which this server calculates

calculated.description: Fields calculated here from reported data

reported.description: Fields taken as reported by the venue

oiChange24h.description: OI change vs a stored hourly snapshot, over the expiries live at both times; absent before such a snapshot exists

newListingOi.description: Coins in expiries listed since the snapshot

settledOi.description: Coins in expiries that settled since the snapshot (not counted as closed)

oiChange7d.description: OI change vs a stored hourly snapshot, over the expiries live at both times; absent before such a snapshot exists

newListingOi.description: Coins in expiries listed since the snapshot

settledOi.description: Coins in expiries that settled since the snapshot (not counted as closed)

state.description: CALL-HEAVY | BALANCED | PUT-HEAVY by put/call OI; descriptive, not a direction signal

callNotionalUsd.description: Call OI notional, USD (calculated at the spot index)

putCallOi.description: Put OI ÷ call OI; absent without call OI

putCallVolume.description: Put ÷ call 24h volume; absent when no calls traded

putNotionalUsd.description: Put OI notional, USD (calculated at the spot index)

tradeFlow.description: Aggressor-side flow of recent trades (who crossed the spread, not who opened or closed positions); absent when trades_hours is 0 or the trade fetch failed

truncated.description: True when the page cap shortened the window

tradeFlowError.description: Why trade flow is missing when it was requested but the trade fetch failed

title: Options Positioning
